extensions.value: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved etoposide, methylprednisolone, cytarabine, and cisplatin (ESHAP) for reimbursement as a treatment option for the treatment of patients with relapsed or refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
